summary: Fix correctly avoids crash when aggregating transformer output changes row count under pandas output config, matching upstream's actual approach; change is minimal and low risk.

issues.description: Stray blank line added at top of file, unrelated to the fix.
Silently skips assigning the original index on length mismatch instead of warning, which could mask unexpected transformer output-length bugs unrelated to aggregation.
Docstring/comment for _wrap_in_pandas_container's index parameter not updated to explain the new length-mismatch skip behavior.
